info.name: Multi-Courier Integration API
info.description: Runnable end-to-end checks for the local API, real UrbaneBolt UAT, and MockCourier. Run the complete collection from the top: Health Check creates fresh IDs for this run, then every request asserts its expected result.

request.description: Creates a UAT-compatible UrbaneBolt shipment through the local API. The first request generates a fresh order ID automatically.

exec: pm.test('UrbaneBolt response is normalized', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.order_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('urbaneboltOrderId')); pm.expect(body.courier_partner).to.eql('urbanebolt'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('CREATED'); pm.expect(body.tracking_number).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Creates a MockCourier shipment using the fresh ID generated by Health Check.

exec: pm.test('MockCourier response is normalized', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.order_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('mockCourierOrderId')); pm.expect(body.courier_partner).to.eql('mockcourier'); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('CREATED'); });

request.description: Checks tracking for the UrbaneBolt order just created.

exec: pm.test('UrbaneBolt tracking is CREATED', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.order_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('urbaneboltOrderId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('CREATED'); pm.expect(body.events).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Cancels the UrbaneBolt order just created.
Confirms that the real UrbaneBolt UAT tracking response is CANCELLED after cancellation.

exec: pm.test('MockCourier tracking is in transit', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.order_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('mockCourierOrderId')); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('IN_TRANSIT'); pm.expect(body.events).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Cancels the MockCourier order after its tracking flow has been tested.
Creates one fresh UAT UrbaneBolt order and one fresh MockCourier order in the same bulk request.

exec: pm.test('both bulk courier orders succeed', () => { const results = pm.response.json().results; pm.expect(results).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(results.every((item) => item.success)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(results.map((item) => item.result.courier_partner)).to.include.members(['urbanebolt', 'mockcourier']); });
